_debit_note: 2026-09-17: switched from selling credit spreads (break-even win rate 67%, losses ran 2-4x wins) to buying debit spreads, gated on Claude news verdict AND Kronos forecast agreeing on direction (disagreement/neutral = no trade). max_debit_to_width 0.40 caps debit at 40% of width so max_profit/max_loss >= ~1.5:1, meaning a much lower win rate can be profitable. debit_enter_pop/roi are separate from the credit-spread enter_pop/roi because a directional bet's raw PoP is structurally lower than a premium-selling PoP — the old 60-65% floors would reject every debit spread. Credit spreads + iron condors are disabled (enable_credit_spreads/enable_iron_condors: false) but the code is kept, not deleted, so this is a one-flag rollback if debit spreads don't work out either. See project memory for the full diagnosis.
_note: Corrected-structure params (hand-edit freely — the auto Strategy Review was removed). Key gate is min_credit_to_width: break-even win rate = 1 - (credit/width), so 0.33 => 67% break-even at ~30-delta. min_dte keeps entries far enough out that theta works before the 21-DTE time stop. ic_min_leg_credit_pct blocks lopsided (directional) condors. max_same_direction prevents a one-side (monoculture) book.
_width_scaling_note: 2026-08-06: max_width was a flat $5 for every ticker regardless of price, which meant only high-price/high-IV megacaps could ever generate the required $1.65 credit (33% of $5) — a live audit found 20/21 daily candidates produced zero spreads that day. max_width_pct now scales the effective per-ticker cap to price (clamped between min_width and max_width), so cheaper/lower-vol names get a reachable width+credit target too. Live-tuned to 0.03 (see 05_calculate_spreads_tradier.py comment) — NOTE: on a thin-IV day the min_pop=60 floor can still leave only 1-2 tickers clearing everything; width was never the only lever. See project_ticker_concentration memory.
_small_account_note: For a ~$500 account, equity-spread math forces narrow trades: set max_width 1.0 and max_risk_pct 0.15 so a single ~$1-wide spread (max loss ~$67 = ~13% of $500) can clear the sizing gate. $1-wide strikes only exist on lower-priced / $1-strike-increment names, so the tradeable universe shrinks. $500 is a prove-it-live stake (~$16 per win), not an income account.
